objective: Test whether one accepted Vela correction can be inspected from a minimal rooted native manifest and a standards-based RO-Crate 1.3 view over the same exact native objects without importing source authority.

native.purpose: Authoritative description of exact Vela identities, roots, source Standing, source authority evidence, completeness, and the absence of local authority.

ro_crate.purpose: Portable file and research-object metadata over the same exact native manifest and object files; it does not replace Vela semantics.

loss_report.rule: Every native semantic plane not represented losslessly by base RO-Crate terms is named explicitly and retained by reference to the native manifest rather than approximated.

sha256_manifest.rule: List the exact bytes of both metadata views, the loss report, deterministic result, reader result, and every native object; exclude only SHA256SUMS itself.

mapping.root_dataset: The package is an RO-Crate Dataset whose hasPart covers the native manifest, loss report, and all 11 native object files.
mapping.native_manifest: The native manifest is a CreativeWork and File identified by its full SHA-256 root.
mapping.native_objects: Each exact native object is a File carrying its Vela role, full object ID, semantic root, byte root, byte size, and JSON or DSSE media type as human-readable metadata.
mapping.decision_semantics: Decision, Verification, Proposal, source Standing, and local Standing remain distinct only in the native manifest and retained Vela bytes; no generic RO-Crate action is allowed to imply Vela authority.

readers.contract: Verify the complete native semantic and signature chain with the existing dependency-free Python reader.
Independently parse the RO-Crate JSON-LD and loss report with Python standard-library JSON only, reject remote fetches, and prove exact parity with the native object set.
Validate the attached package against the external base RO-Crate profile in an isolated temporary environment; this result is supporting interoperability evidence, not Vela authority.

determinism.timestamps: copied only from exact source Decision bytes
determinism.ordering: lexicographic by path and entity identifier
determinism.serialization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, and one final LF
determinism.requirement: Both clean temporary rebuilds must be byte-identical for ro-crate-metadata.json, vela-loss-report.json, reader-result.json, result.json, and SHA256SUMS.

stop_conditions: Native manifest root, object-set root, object count, Claim root, or Decision root differs from the frozen source.
Any listed native object is unavailable, escapes the package root, or has different bytes.
RO-Crate maps Verification or file provenance to Vela acceptance.
Source Standing is presented as local Standing.
A semantic loss is omitted from the loss report.
Generation or clean-room verification requires network access, authority credentials, Frontier mutation, or a hosted Vela service.
nonclaims: RO-Crate validation verifies scientific truth, Vela signatures, or Vela Standing.
The source Frontier's accepted Standing has authority in a receiving Frontier.
This first-party package demonstrates external adoption or measured user lift.
This experiment establishes a Vela ontology, Registry, federation protocol, or new canonical service.
